title: "Palmer_Penguins_Dashboard"

format: dashboard

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

 penguins  <-  penguins 

```

# Page 1

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}

mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot() 

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r}

bill_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

```

```{r}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

```


 

# Page 2

This dataset describes 344 individual penguins and comes from the `palmer penguins` package. These 3 species of penguins live on 3 different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
penguins <- penguins %>%   
  select(-c(year))
  
knitr::kable(penguins)
```
